title: Next.js 15 に Turbopack を試す

comments.author: thaddeusjiang
comments.body_markdown:
# 1. Sentry 関連依頼が Warning 

```log
⚠ ./node_modules/.pnpm/@sentry+node@10.11.0/node_modules/@sentry/node/build/cjs/sdk
Package import-in-the-middle can't be external
The request import-in-the-middle matches serverExternalPackages (or the default list).
The package resolves to a different version when requested from the project directory (2.0.0) compared to the package requested from the importing module (1.14.2).
Make sure to install the same version of the package in both locations.

```

解決方法：Next.js と Sentry バージョンアップ

最低バージョン：
* Next.js 15.4.1
* Sentry 10.13.0

![](https://storage.googleapis.com/zenn-user-upload/d443417c945e-20251119.png)

https://github.com/getsentry/sentry-javascript/issues/8105#issuecomment-3319437023
